changed.what: Registry path and rows put in N38a-12's [[ka]] schema (known_answers/foundry.toml); KA-168 to 171 become [[ka_ref]] cross-references to N10-KA3 (no KA registered twice); Parts 3 and 4 become [[derived]] records; per-row due milestone (M5; M6 for KA-750 to 753; M8 for KA-749) with pending-before-due so the registry closes before its carriers; N38b-34's controls cited for KA-747/750/753/754 and its ratio-two control added to KA-754; 'to set' tolerances tied to N38b-27 (now a dep) and KA-739 exact for closed forms; coverage script logs via STD-E2E; new tests for these.

Ceiling figures moved from a private docs/sources file into the NAB-09 source register as typed figures with [[source.reread]] records (confirmed/corrected/not-found/changed); ceiling.rs holds no literals; un-reread figures not citable by a gate; tests for corrected re-read and citation refusal.
N33bx-04 (VolumeMesher) and N33bx-05 (MassProperties) moved from related to deps: the mesh and massprops wrappers are built over those airlock traits.

Added a Checker trait beside Rung so the machine is built and tested with synthetic rungs and checkers; real rungs (N31a-15/16/17) and the independent check (BD-402) are plugged in by capstone BD-403; last criterion reworded (record fields shown here, the real stage-2 comparison is BD-403/N31a-54); tests loop_record_has_stage2_fields and checker_is_pluggable.
Stale-ModelId refusal given its code: FROB-REF-167, pointer model, exit 3, before any residual.

Example JSON fixed (signs and moments were inconsistent; now an exact 0.2 kg shank case with zero residual); trot-traction support pattern (mu*N tangential, tilted effective gravity) added; step 5 rewritten so the M4 pilot N31b-06 (now a dep) computes its own three cases and this generator must reproduce them, with the traction-case knee difference stated exactly; KILL-LOADS refusal is FROB-REF-724 (exit 5); e2e step for it; new tests.
N31a-17, N31a-19, N31a-20 moved to deps: the bead's acceptance criteria run extraction and the stress and buckling checks on extruded plates.

Precedence rule: a two-size cycle has lambda-hat = 1 and also meets the divergence test, so cycling is tested first; diverged only without alternation-within-band; test with a growing oscillation (lambda-hat 1.5) and planted defect divergence-tested-first.
N31a-14 added to deps: the envelope check reads the design region record.

Overhang filter range fixed: smax/smin biases make a dense block settle at 1.0044911, which breaks the sibling stage contract [0,1] (NFx-02) and the stated idempotence; output now xi/xi_full in [0,1] with exact derivative (hard clip rejected); KAs, metamorphic tolerance (0.005) and a planted no-output-scaling defect updated; filter placement now reads the NFx-02 capability row (structure.external_design_stage), stale 'no upstream item' consideration replaced; cutter sizes stated as radii.

Battery would have failed by its own rule: corner-radius fixtures also raise a co-located gouge (and the 2 mm bore a corner-radius finding), and the 2.4 mm slot with a 3 mm cutter gouged along its length; added secondary findings to the table and matching rule, replaced the slot by a 10 mm pocket with 1.2 mm corners, added clean-margin rules for the generator and tests for co-location and unexpected findings.

notes: All KA and fixture arithmetic in the slice was recomputed and is correct (cantilever, rainflow 8.752e-6/7.816e-6, loop iterates, tube inertia, allocation, two-link and odometry sensitivities, sphere overhang 184.0 mm2, statics). N31a-31 checked in detail, including rationality of axis-tilt sensitivities at rational poses (theta cancels for revolute joints); left unchanged. Graph: no cycles after edits; all new deps are at or before M5. Edited files validated: front matter complete, lists one-line JSON, seven sections, no dep also in related.
